title: Check adjoint BIT multi-donor prices and replay a lower-work zero-net word
body:
The original-pulse adjoint census checks 25,527,581 triples. The 411 eligible aliases on the 137 one-to-three-helper supports give 28 exact ties and 383 negative prices. The separate one-extra-helper direct-pulse gate covers 30,069 cases with none positive.

An exact recompiled control preserves both native operators on 679 surviving owners. Its full 36-call signed histograms cancel, while modeled ordinary records fall from 934,182,831,504 to 933,664,973,520 and backing from 6,998,544 to 6,998,472. Both proposed donor rewrites can be removed after specialization, so this is a separate ordinary-resource result.

Pins #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 and complements the forward chronology in #7905. The clean Python and C++ replay reproduces all nine fixtures, both literal directions and corruption/retirement controls. Source contributors credited. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Post-recode cascades, larger helper supports and the complete physical and finite transfer remain open.
